privacy.title: Privacy Policy
content: Last updated: March 2026
1. INTRODUCTION

Bynot ("we", "our") is a mobile integrated development environment (IDE) that lets you create, edit, and manage software projects directly from your device. This notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and other applicable data protection laws.
2. DATA WE COLLECT
2.1 Account data
When you create an account, we collect:
• Email address
• Display name
• Authentication method (email/password, Google, Apple)
2.2 Usage data
We automatically collect:
• Device identifier (for session management)
• Data about created projects (name, type, configuration)
• Interaction logs with the AI assistant (prompts and responses)
• AI budget usage statistics
2.3 Payment data

Subscription payments are handled entirely by Apple through In-App Purchase. We do not collect or store credit card or financial information. We only receive the transaction identifier from Apple to verify subscription status.
3. HOW WE USE DATA
We use your data to:
• Provide and maintain the Bynot service
• Manage your account and preferences
• Process requests to the AI assistant
• Manage subscription-plan limits
• Send push notifications (if enabled) about your project status
• Send transactional emails (e.g., email verification, security alerts)
• Improve the service and fix errors
4. THIRD-PARTY DATA PROCESSORS
We share your data with the following third-party processors, each acting under a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) in accordance with GDPR Article 28:
4.1 Firebase (Google LLC)
Purpose: Authentication, database, cloud storage, push notifications
Data shared: Email address, display name, project data, push notification tokens, analytics
Privacy policy: https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy
4.2 Anthropic
Purpose: AI assistant (Claude)
Data shared: Chat prompts sent in anonymized form, without direct association to your account
Privacy policy: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy
4.3 OpenAI
Purpose: AI assistant (GPT)
Data shared: Chat prompts sent in anonymized form, without direct association to your account
Privacy policy: https://openai.com/privacy
4.4 Google AI
Purpose: AI assistant (Gemini)
Data shared: Chat prompts sent in anonymized form, without direct association to your account
Privacy policy: https://ai.google/privacy
4.5 Groq
Purpose: AI assistant (Llama)
Data shared: Chat prompts sent in anonymized form, without direct association to your account
Privacy policy: https://groq.com/privacy-policy
4.6 Expo (650 Industries, Inc.)
Purpose: Push notifications, over-the-air updates
Data shared: Push notification token, device information
Privacy policy: https://expo.dev/privacy
4.7 Resend
Purpose: Transactional emails (email verification, notifications)
Data shared: Email address
Privacy policy: https://resend.com/legal/privacy-policy
4.8 Apple (Apple Inc.)
Purpose: In-App Purchase payment processing, Sign in with Apple authentication
Data shared: Payment information is handled entirely by Apple via the App Store; we only receive a transaction identifier
Privacy policy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy
5. INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFERS

Your personal data may be transferred to and processed in countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA), including the United States, where our third-party processors (Firebase, AI providers, Expo, Resend) maintain their servers.
These transfers are protected by appropriate safeguards in accordance with GDPR Article 46, including:
• Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission
• Google's Data Processing Addendum, which includes SCCs for international transfers (https://cloud.google.com/terms/data-processing-addendum)
• Binding Corporate Rules where applicable

By using Bynot, you acknowledge that your data may be processed in the United States and other jurisdictions that may have different data protection laws than your country of residence. We ensure that all transfers comply with applicable data protection regulations and that your data receives an adequate level of protection.
6. DATA RETENTION
Account data is retained as long as your account remains active. Project data is retained for the lifetime of the project. You can request deletion of your data at any time.
7. SECURITY
We apply technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
• Encrypted communications (HTTPS/TLS)
• Secure authentication through Firebase
• Data access limited to the account owner
• Isolated execution environment for each project (Docker containers)
8. DATA BREACH NOTIFICATION
In the event of a personal data breach that poses a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will:
• Notify the competent supervisory authority within 72 hours of becoming aware of the breach, in accordance with GDPR Article 33
• Notify affected users without undue delay when the breach is likely to result in a high risk to their rights and freedoms, in accordance with GDPR Article 34
• Notification to users will be sent via email to the address associated with your account
• The notification will describe the nature of the breach, the likely consequences, and the measures taken or proposed to address the breach
9. YOUR RIGHTS
Under GDPR and CCPA, you have the right to:
• Access your personal data (GDPR Art. 15 / CCPA right to know)
• Correct inaccurate data (GDPR Art. 16)
• Request deletion of your account and associated data (GDPR Art. 17 / CCPA right to delete)
• Restrict processing of your data (GDPR Art. 18)
• Data portability — export your data in a structured, machine-readable format (GDPR Art. 20)
• Object to processing of your data (GDPR Art. 21)
• Withdraw consent for push notifications and non-essential communications at any time
• Not be discriminated against for exercising your privacy rights (CCPA)

For California residents: You have the right to know what personal information is collected, disclosed, or sold, and the right to opt out of the sale of personal information. Bynot does not sell personal information.
To exercise these rights, contact us at the address below. We will respond within 30 days (or 45 days for CCPA requests, with the possibility of a 45-day extension upon notice).
10. AI USAGE AND TRANSPARENCY (EU AI ACT)
Bynot integrates AI-powered features to assist with software development. In compliance with the EU AI Act, we provide the following transparency information:

• AI-generated content: Code, suggestions, and other content generated by the AI assistant is machine-generated. It may contain errors, inaccuracies, security vulnerabilities, or outdated information. AI-generated output should not be considered professional advice.

• User responsibility: You are solely responsible for reviewing, testing, and validating all AI-generated code before deploying it to any environment, especially production systems. The AI system should not be relied upon for security-critical or safety-critical decisions.

• System limitations: The AI assistant has inherent limitations. It may produce incorrect, biased, or incomplete results. It does not have access to real-time information and its knowledge has a training cutoff date.
• User control: You can disable AI features at any time through the app settings. Using AI features is entirely optional and not required for core IDE functionality.

• Data processing by AI providers: When you use the AI assistant, your prompts are sent to third-party AI providers (listed in Section 4) for processing. These providers may process prompts according to their own privacy policies. Prompts are sent in anonymized form without direct association to your account.
11. EMAIL COMMUNICATIONS
11.1 Types of emails we send
• Transactional emails: Email verification, password reset, security alerts. These are essential for account functionality and cannot be opted out of.
• Service notifications: Important updates about your account, subscription changes, or service modifications.
11.2 Opting out

You can opt out of non-essential email communications by contacting us at the address below. Note that you cannot opt out of transactional emails that are necessary for account security and functionality (e.g., email verification).
11.3 CAN-SPAM compliance

All emails sent by Bynot comply with the CAN-SPAM Act. Every email includes our physical business address, a clear identification of the message as from Bynot, and instructions for opting out of future non-essential communications.
12. CHILDREN

Bynot is not intended for children under 13 (or under 16 in the EEA). We do not knowingly collect data from children. If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a child, we will take steps to delete such data promptly.
13. CHANGES

We reserve the right to update this notice. Significant changes will be communicated through the app with at least 30 days' notice before the changes take effect. Continued use of Bynot after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
14. CONTACT
For privacy questions or to exercise your data protection rights:
Email: privacy@bynot.it
General support: support@bynot.it
Address: Bynot Dev, Italy
If you are unsatisfied with our response, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority.

terms.title: Terms of Service
content: Last updated: March 2026
1. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS
By using Bynot ("the App"), you accept these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
2. SERVICE DESCRIPTION
Bynot is a mobile integrated development environment (IDE) that offers:
• Software project creation and management
• Code editor with real-time preview
• AI assistant for development
• Git repository management (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket)
• Cloud project storage
• Cloud containers (workstations) for code execution and preview
3. ACCOUNT
3.1 Registration
To use Bynot you must create an account. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential.
3.2 One device at a time
For security reasons, your account can be active on only one device at a time. Signing in from a new device ends the active session.
3.3 User content
You retain ownership of all code and content you create through Bynot. You are responsible for the content you upload and the projects you create.
4. SUBSCRIPTIONS AND PAYMENTS
4.1 Plans
Bynot offers different plans: Free, Go, and Pro. Features and limits for each plan are described in the app.
4.2 Billing
• Payments are handled through Apple In-App Purchase
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at purchase confirmation
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• The renewal cost is charged within 24 hours before the end of the current period
• You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings after purchase
4.3 Refunds
Refunds are handled by Apple according to its policies. You can request a refund via reportaproblem.apple.com.
5. USE OF THE AI ASSISTANT
5.1 AI budget
Each plan includes a monthly AI budget. Usage is tracked and resets monthly.
5.2 AI-generated content
The AI assistant generates suggestions and code. You are responsible for reviewing and using generated content. We do not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of AI responses.
5.3 AI-generated code disclaimer

AI-generated code should be reviewed by the user before deployment to any production environment. Bynot is not liable for security vulnerabilities, bugs, functional defects, or legal issues arising from AI-generated code. Users are solely responsible for ensuring that AI-generated code complies with all applicable open-source licenses, third-party intellectual property rights, and regulatory requirements.
6. USAGE RESTRICTIONS
You may not:
• Use the app for illegal activities
• Attempt to bypass plan limits or security measures
• Share your account credentials
• Use the app to create harmful or malicious content
• Reverse engineer the app
7. CONTAINER USAGE POLICY
7.1 Prohibited uses
Users may not use cloud containers (workstations) provided by Bynot for:
• Cryptocurrency mining or any form of distributed computing for financial gain
• Launching or participating in Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks
• Port scanning, network probing, or brute force attacks
• Hosting, distributing, or developing malware, viruses, or other malicious software
• Sending spam, phishing emails, or conducting social engineering attacks
• Storing or distributing illegal content
• Any activity that violates applicable local, national, or international law
7.2 Enforcement
Bynot reserves the right to immediately terminate containers and suspend or permanently ban accounts without prior notice in the event of violations of this policy.
7.3 Resource limits
Resource limits (CPU, memory, storage, bandwidth) apply per subscription plan tier and are described in the app. Attempts to circumvent resource limits constitute a violation of these Terms.
7.4 Monitoring

Bynot may monitor aggregate container resource usage for the purposes of abuse prevention, capacity planning, and enforcement of these Terms. Bynot does not inspect the content of user code except where required to investigate a reported violation.
8. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
The Bynot app, its design, source code, and trademarks are owned by Bynot. You receive a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the app.
9. COPYRIGHT AND DMCA
9.1 Respect for intellectual property
Bynot respects the intellectual property rights of others and expects its users to do the same.
9.2 Reporting copyright infringement
If you believe that content hosted on or published through the Bynot platform infringes your copyright, you may submit a takedown notice to abuse@bynot.it. Your notice must include:
• A description of the copyrighted work you believe has been infringed
• The URL or other specific identification of the infringing content on Bynot
• Your full name, mailing address, telephone number, and email address
• A statement that you have a good-faith belief that the use of the material is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law
• A statement, made under penalty of perjury, that the information in the notice is accurate and that you are the copyright owner or authorized to act on the owner's behalf
• Your physical or electronic signature
9.3 Response to notices

Upon receipt of a valid takedown notice, Bynot will review the claim and may remove or disable access to the allegedly infringing content within 48 hours. The affected user will be notified of the takedown.
9.4 Counter-notification
If you believe your content was removed in error or is not infringing, you may submit a counter-notification to abuse@bynot.it including:
• Identification of the content that was removed and its prior location
• A statement under penalty of perjury that you have a good-faith belief the content was removed by mistake or misidentification
• Your name, address, telephone number, and email address
• A statement that you consent to the jurisdiction of the courts in Milan, Italy, and that you will accept service of process from the person who filed the original takedown notice
• Your physical or electronic signature
Upon receipt of a valid counter-notification, Bynot may restore the removed content within 10-14 business days unless the original complainant initiates legal proceedings.
9.5 Repeat infringers
Bynot will terminate the accounts of users who are found to be repeat copyright infringers. A user may be deemed a repeat infringer after two or more valid takedown notices.
10. SERVICE AVAILABILITY AND SLA
10.1 Availability
Bynot strives to maintain service availability but does not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free access to the platform.
10.2 Scheduled maintenance
Scheduled maintenance will be communicated to users in advance when reasonably possible. Bynot will make reasonable efforts to schedule maintenance during off-peak hours.
10.3 Data responsibility

Bynot is not liable for data loss resulting from service interruptions, infrastructure failures, or any other cause. Users are strongly encouraged to maintain local copies and independent backups of their projects and source code.
10.4 Service credits

In the event of extended unplanned outages exceeding 24 consecutive hours, affected paid subscribers may request a pro-rata credit for the affected period by contacting legal@bynot.it within 30 days of the outage. Credits will be applied to the next billing cycle and do not constitute a cash refund.
11. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Bynot is provided "as is". We are not liable for:
• Loss of data or code due to malfunctions
• Damage arising from the use of AI-generated content
• Service interruptions
• Problems caused by third-party services
Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the subscription in the previous 12 months.
12. FORCE MAJEURE

Neither party shall be held liable for any failure or delay in the performance of its obligations under these Terms where such failure or delay results from causes beyond reasonable control. Such causes include, but are not limited to: natural disasters (earthquakes, floods, hurricanes), war, armed conflict, terrorism, pandemics, epidemics, government actions or sanctions, labor disputes, power failures, internet or telecommunications outages, cyberattacks, or the failure, suspension, or degradation of third-party service providers (including but not limited to Firebase, cloud infrastructure providers, and AI service providers). The affected party must notify the other party promptly and make reasonable efforts to mitigate the impact.
13. EU CONSUMER RIGHTS AND RIGHT OF WITHDRAWAL
13.1 Right of withdrawal

In accordance with EU Directive 2011/83/EU on consumer rights, consumers residing in the European Union have the right to withdraw from a subscription contract within 14 calendar days of purchase, without providing any reason.
13.2 Digital content exception

By beginning to use the digital service (including accessing or downloading digital content, running containers, or using the AI assistant), you expressly acknowledge and agree that the right of withdrawal may be limited or forfeited for digital content that has been accessed, streamed, or downloaded, in accordance with Article 16(m) of EU Directive 2011/83/EU.
13.3 How to exercise withdrawal

To exercise your right of withdrawal, you must notify us by sending a clear, unambiguous statement to legal@bynot.it before the expiration of the 14-day withdrawal period. Upon valid withdrawal, we will reimburse all payments received from you without undue delay and no later than 14 days from the date we are informed of your decision to withdraw.
14. TERMINATION
We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms. You can delete your account at any time from the app settings.
15. CHANGES TO TERMS
We reserve the right to modify these terms. Significant changes will be communicated through the app with at least 30 days' notice.
16. GOVERNING LAW

These terms are governed by Italian law. Any dispute is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Milan, Italy. For consumers residing in the European Union, mandatory consumer protection provisions of their country of residence shall also apply.
17. CONTACT
For questions about the terms of service:
Email: legal@bynot.it
For copyright/DMCA notices:
Email: abuse@bynot.it
